title: Technician charge-out on a phone refuses an inactive part number
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919), a role that has 'Part Library & Inventory → View', 'Create & Edit' and 'Delete'.
  • {Technician-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST PL TECHPHONE) is a staff member at {Location-A} with the default Technician role.
  • A phone with a web browser is available, and {Technician-A} is signed in on it at {Location-A}.
  • Inventory part {Part-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-TECHPHONE-01), with description {Description-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST PL TECHPHONE PART A), is tracked at {Location-A} with 4 in its default bin and is inactive.
  • Work order {Work-order-1} (for example S2-15440) is open and has an approved line, {Line-1} (for example "ZZAUTOTEST PL TECHPHONE line"), with {Technician-A} as a technician and no parts.
custom_steps:
1. On the phone open {Work-order-1}.
  2. Under {Line-1} tap "+ Add Part".
  3. Type the start of {Part-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-TECHP) in the part field.
  4. Clear the field and type {Part-A} in full, all in lower case.
  5. Tap the row's "Save".
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 3: No row for {Part-A} is offered.
  • Step 4: The field shows the error "{Part-A} is inactive. Activate it from the Inactive tab to use it." under it, naming {Part-A} as it was saved.
  • Step 5: The row is not saved and {Line-1} gets no new part.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10822 (Story 9, Inactive Parts Cannot Be Added to New Work); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, as edited 9 Oct 2026 (Ready for dev), S9-R3, S9-R16, read 13 Oct 2026; design canvas board 6.3 (desktop only; the design has no phone board), 13 Oct copy. Tech plan "Parts Lifecycle Update — Technical Implementation Plan", 7 Oct 2026 (informs, never overrules), §7 Manual testing checklist. Source-verified 13 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Part Lifecycle QA build exists).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S9-R3: “Technician charge-out part selection does not return inactive parts, on every device.”
  • PRD §2 Feature Overview, Form factor: “Story 9 applies on every device, including technician charge-out on a phone.”
  • S9-R16: “When the number typed in a part lookup matches an inactive part at this location, the lookup does not offer to add it as a special order. It shows "{part number} is inactive. Activate it from the Inactive tab to use it.", naming the inactive part's number. On technician charge-out, where a typed number is taken straight from the field, the field shows the same message as its error and the line cannot be saved.”
  • Tech plan (Parts Lifecycle Update, 7 Oct 2026), §7 Manual testing checklist, item 6: “Tech View charge-out at phone width: a typed inactive number blocks the save with the message under the field.”
